title: Packet retention-failure memory: test the removal hooks with an existing entry; refresh the publish doc comment
outcome: The delegation-removal and parent-session-removal cleanup of remembered packet retention failures is covered by tests that fail without it, and the publish_terminal_review_for_packet doc comment states the remembered-failure contract.
acceptance: A behavioural test remembers a packet retention failure (map holds one entry), then removes the delegation, and asserts the entry is gone; a second case removes the parent session instead. Each test fails if the matching retain call in record_removed_delegation or record_removed_session is removed.

The publish_terminal_review_for_packet doc comment describes the lock scope (lookup, pruning and write-back under the state lock, never across capture I/O) and that a failure is served without a new capture until the record identity changes; the disabled-storage test notes that its gate is test-only.
